model.description: Model identity, sizing inputs, and optional maximum model context length.

workload.description: Inference request concurrency and token shape assumptions.

deployment.description: Deployment scale and Azure virtual machine procurement option.

optimization.description: Ranking preference and optional deployment-wide hourly cost limit.

targetVmSizes.description: The Azure virtual machine candidate set. When supplied, only these virtual machine sizes are ranked. Entries must be non-blank and unique, compared case-insensitively.

subscriptionOptions.description: The subscription-scoped lookups to include in the recommendation.

huggingFaceModelId.description: The Hugging Face model identifier, for example `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct`.

parameterCount.description: The logical total model parameter count, including all mixture-of-experts experts. May be supplied with or without a model identifier.

weightPrecision.description: The precision the model weights are served at. Matched case-insensitively.

numLayers.description: The model layer count, used for architecture-aware key-value cache sizing. Supply all architecture fields together with a parameter count.

numKeyValueHeads.description: The model key-value head count, used for architecture-aware key-value cache sizing. Supply all architecture fields together with a parameter count.

headDim.description: The attention head dimension, used for architecture-aware key-value cache sizing. Supply all architecture fields together with a parameter count.

maxContextLength.description: The maximum context length the model supports, in tokens. Used only as an upper bound for the sizing context length when Hugging Face metadata provides no usable maximum.

maxConcurrentRequestsPerReplica.description: The maximum number of simultaneous inference requests handled by each deployment replica.

tokenBudget.description: The prompt and output token budget used for key-value cache sizing.

promptTokens.description: The number of prompt, or input, tokens per inference request. Must be supplied together with `maxOutputTokens`, and the two must total from 1 through 131072.

maxOutputTokens.description: The maximum number of generated output tokens per inference request. Must be supplied together with `promptTokens`, and the two must total from 1 through 131072.

replicaCount.description: The number of deployment replicas used for cost, quota, and placement calculations.

procurementOption.description: The Azure virtual machine procurement option.

rankingPreference.description: The preference used to rank the recommended options.

amount.description: The maximum cost per hour for the whole deployment. Must be greater than zero when supplied.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency code the amount is expressed in. The recommendation service currently supports `USD`.

includeQuota.description: Whether to evaluate subscription quota for candidate virtual machine sizes.

includePlacement.description: Whether to query placement scores for candidate virtual machine sizes with available quota.

includePricing.description: Whether to fetch subscription-scoped virtual machine pricing.

options.description: The recommended virtual machine size options, ordered from the best to the worst match.

sizing.description: The resolved workload sizing shared by every option.

vmSize.description: The Azure virtual machine size name, for example `Standard_NC24ads_A100_v4`.

recommendationRank.description: The rank of this option within the response, where 1 is the best match.

readiness.description: How ready this option is to deploy.

topology.description: The deployment topology for this option.

cost.description: The deployment cost for this option.

quota.description: The subscription quota evidence for this option. Returned only when `subscriptionOptions.includeQuota` is set.

placement.description: The capacity placement evidence for this option. Returned only when `subscriptionOptions.includePlacement` is set.

azureMlRecommended.description: Whether the Azure Machine Learning model catalog recommends this virtual machine size for the model.

benchmark.description: The external benchmark evidence selected for this option.

documentationUrl.description: A URL to the Azure documentation page for this virtual machine size.

performanceEstimate.description: The advisory deployment throughput and per-request latency estimate for this option.

status.description: The current actionability of the recommendation.

reason.description: A human-readable explanation of the readiness status.

estimatedNodeCountPerReplica.description: The estimated number of virtual machine nodes required for a single replica.

estimatedTotalNodeCount.description: The estimated total number of virtual machine nodes across all replicas.

accelerator.description: The accelerator hardware available in each virtual machine.

model.description: The accelerator model name, for example `A100` or `H100`.

countPerVm.description: The number of accelerator devices in each virtual machine.

memoryGiBPerAccelerator.description: The memory capacity of a single accelerator device, in gibibytes.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency code all amounts in this object are expressed in.

vmHourly.description: The price per hour for a single virtual machine, in the stated currency.

deploymentHourly.description: The price per hour for the whole deployment, in the stated currency.

source.description: The source the price was resolved from.

priceAsOf.description: The date and time the price was observed.

error.description: The error that prevented subscription-scoped pricing from being resolved, if any.

code.description: The reason the stage did not complete.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.

status.description: Whether subscription quota is sufficient for the requested deployment.

reason.description: A human-readable explanation of the quota status.

error.description: The error that prevented quota from being evaluated, if any.

maxAvailableReplicaCount.description: The maximum number of replicas that can be deployed with the available quota.

increase.description: The quota increase required before this option can be deployed.

limits.description: The individual quota limits that block the requested deployment.

portalUrl.description: A URL to the Azure portal page for submitting the quota increase.

name.description: The name of the quota to raise.

currentUsage.description: The current usage against the quota.

requiredLimit.description: The quota limit required to deploy the workload.

status.description: The outcome of the placement query.

reason.description: A human-readable explanation of the placement status.

error.description: The error that prevented placement from being evaluated, if any.

recommendedAvailabilityZones.description: The availability zones recommended for the deployment, in preference order.

level.description: How closely the benchmark evidence matches the recommended topology.

modelClass.description: The model size class the benchmark covers, for example `70b`.

scenario.description: The benchmark scenario, for example `Server` or `Offline`.

submitterCount.description: The number of submitters that published results for this configuration.

submissionId.description: The identifier of the selected benchmark submission.

benchmarkModel.description: The model the benchmark was measured on.

submitter.description: The organization that published the benchmark submission.

system.description: The system the benchmark was measured on.

throughput.description: The throughput observed in the benchmark submission.

throughputUnit.description: The unit the observed throughput is expressed in, for example `Tokens/s`.

software.description: The serving software the benchmark was measured with.

operatingSystem.description: The operating system the benchmark was measured on.

weightDataTypes.description: The weight data types used in the benchmark submission.

p99TtftMs.description: The 99th-percentile time to first token observed in the benchmark, in milliseconds.

p99TpotMs.description: The 99th-percentile time per output token observed in the benchmark, in milliseconds.

deploymentOutputTokensPerSecond.description: The estimated number of output tokens generated per second across the whole deployment.

ttftMs.description: The estimated time to first token for a single request, in milliseconds.

model.description: The resolved model identity and weight precision.

workload.description: The resolved per-replica workload inputs used for memory sizing.

memory.description: The memory calculation shared by every returned option.

basis.description: The sources used for the sizing calculation.

parameterCount.description: The logical total model parameter count used for sizing.

weightPrecision.description: The precision the model weights were sized at.

huggingFaceModelId.description: The Hugging Face model identifier the sizing metadata was resolved from.

maxConcurrentRequestsPerReplica.description: The maximum number of simultaneous inference requests handled by each replica.

contextLength.description: The context length, in tokens, used to size the key-value cache: the sum of `promptTokens` and `maxOutputTokens` when a token budget is supplied, otherwise the service default.

modelWeightsGiB.description: The memory required for the model weights, in gibibytes.

kvCacheGiBPerRequest.description: The key-value cache memory required for a single concurrent request, in gibibytes.

kvCacheGiBTotal.description: The key-value cache memory required for all concurrent requests on a replica, in gibibytes.

modelAndKvCacheGiB.description: The combined model-weight and key-value cache memory required per replica, in gibibytes.

parameterCountSource.description: Where the model parameter count was resolved from.

modelWeightsCalculation.description: How the model weight memory was calculated.

contextLengthSource.description: Where the context length was resolved from.
